name: Related Media Grouping Reliability
changes: Expands Related Media set classification to common bracketed and index/total filename sequence formats while requiring explicit sequence evidence.
Normalizes punctuation separators and canonical poster email identity so obvious members are not split by cosmetic naming differences.
Protects bare year-like numeric suffixes from accidental set classification.
Uses stable article identity during Continuous grouped-gallery promotion instead of removing older cards by a stored array index.
Updates the guarded publisher to accept a successful Pages deployment on either the reviewed source commit or the trigger-only commit.
regression_guards: Related Media still requires at least three members and remains isolated by newsgroup, media kind, normalized base, and poster identity.
Related Media cover probing, thumbnail scheduling, gallery virtualization, viewer behavior, and browsing concurrency remain unchanged.
The v3.7.3 managed /SILENT Setup lifecycle and exact launch arguments remain unchanged.
Private SABnzbd 5.1.2 and SABCTools 9.6.3 provenance remain unchanged.
preserved: Private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Direct Unpack/post-processing, PAR2/repair, article cache and async disk behavior.
Automation, Smart Import, Backup & Restore, themes, and all non-grouping Newsgroup Browser tuning.
Metadata Server 0.3.3 and Diagnostic Collector 1.0.31 remain separate unchanged components.
